'''2002 Genghis Con tournament (16 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Genghis Con, Denver, Colorado on 16 February 2002. It is known from Edward Rivas's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3391">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-19-denver-colorado-02-15-02d3391/ denver-colorado-02-15-02], DeckTech (Edward "Devil Dog" Rivas, 19 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-19-denver-colorado-02-15-02d3391/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 February 2002
* '''Site:''' Genghis Con, Denver, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
